findings.title: Outer session census does not include the actual install session
findings.affected_scope: Actual v10x setup and any claim that X1-X4 proves installation exclusion
findings.owner: Canonical setup-exclusion builder; parent for applicability disposition
findings.evidence_and_trace: The launcher owns SESSION=$PID for the setsid gate/timeout/runner and releases after own_group_current of that SESSION reports empty; the real v10x runner starts npm through another setsid and closes npm's fd 9. If the runner exits or its timeout kills it while that nested npm session remains live or unknown, the outer session can be empty, and the outer holder can release the canonical lease without checking the install session. This is a new outer/inner integration defect, not a re-audit of the primitive. [Launcher lines 160-174](/home/user/workspace/tgp-private-evidence/2026-09-22/op88/remediation/s5-setup-exclusion/launch-s5-setup-exclusion.v1.sh#L160) [Setup lines 219-241](/home/user/workspace/tgp-private-evidence/2026-09-22/op88/remediation/s5-setup-exclusion/run-s5-setup-npm-ci.v10x.sh#L219)
findings.control_gap: The descendant fake stays in the outer runner's session; the overrun fake is only sleep in that session, so neither exercises the actual nested-session boundary. [Fake runner lines 5-7](/home/user/workspace/tgp-private-evidence/2026-09-22/op88/remediation/s5-setup-exclusion/controls-exclusion/fake-runner.sh#L5)
findings.smallest_closure: Use the existing exact inner attempt identity to keep the install session in the outer exclusion decision, or make a narrowly reviewed consumer adaptation that genuinely keeps the workload inside the observed ownership domain. Then add one private nested-session fake, with fd 9 closed in the fake workload, that outlives runner failure and demonstrates retained exclusion until that exact workload is observed empty. Do not run npm to establish this proof.

findings.title: Exceptional census forgets unresolved session authority after collecting the leader
findings.affected_scope: Exceptional cleanup, census-error, foreign-number and SELF-HOLD release decisions
findings.evidence_and_trace: exceptional calls own_collect before census_state, and self_hold calls it before each heartbeat census; the frozen interface's own_collect invokes own_retire, which removes both the exited leader and its group from the registry. Thus a gone leader plus a surviving or unknown session can become an empty registry: even when reap_rc is nonzero and exceptional first enters SELF-HOLD, its next empty-registry census can release. The new consumer must not use registry emptiness after retirement as proof of exact session emptiness. [Launcher lines 134,143-153](/home/user/workspace/tgp-private-evidence/2026-09-22/op88/remediation/s5-setup-exclusion/launch-s5-setup-exclusion.v1.sh#L134) [Frozen interface lines 72-84](/home/user/workspace/tgp-private-evidence/2026-09-22/op88/remediation/s5-setup-exclusion/inputs/own-block-v10.sh#L72)
findings.additional_same_cause: census_state also treats own_census rc 0 as empty, although the frozen interface deliberately reports FOREIGN_NUMBER without a nonzero result; that is incompatible with this launcher's explicit foreign-number SELF-HOLD requirement. [Launcher lines 134,176](/home/user/workspace/tgp-private-evidence/2026-09-22/op88/remediation/s5-setup-exclusion/launch-s5-setup-exclusion.v1.sh#L134) [Frozen interface lines 77-80](/home/user/workspace/tgp-private-evidence/2026-09-22/op88/remediation/s5-setup-exclusion/inputs/own-block-v10.sh#L77)

findings.title: Signal and release paths do not preserve complete raw/publication outcome truth
findings.affected_scope: Exact final status and retained evidence
findings.evidence_and_trace: A signal during RUNNING can invoke exceptional while RAW is still none; own_collect can obtain the wait result in the log but never copies it into RAW/RAW_RC, so the resulting release record may retain raw=none rather than the observed exit or explicit unobserved status. Separately, release writes LEASE_RELEASE with the current publication field, then calls publish_state RELEASED; if that later publication fails it still exits with the earlier rc and leaves the release record with the earlier publication value. PUBLICATION is also a replaceable scalar, so later failures can erase an earlier failure cause. These are outer-consumer evidence defects, not claims that the unchanged primitive's wait mechanism is broken. [Launcher lines 128-148,151,168-174](/home/user/workspace/tgp-private-evidence/2026-09-22/op88/remediation/s5-setup-exclusion/launch-s5-setup-exclusion.v1.sh#L128)
findings.smallest_closure: Latch raw observation in the owning shell on the signal/exception path before collection retires the child, and retain publication failures without overwriting prior outcomes or announcing final success before the final required state write. Add one private signal case and one final holder-update failure case; preserve actual exits and failed records.
